decisions.reason: As a software product close to the core offer and the firm's data-driven direction, and with the firm showing growth, hiring, and R&D slack, its performance likely meets aspirations well enough to keep it unless clearer signs of underperformance emerge.

This product is also close to the established automation business and strategically aligned with connected infrastructure management, so a medium innovative firm with some slack would more likely retain it, though its shorter track record makes removal slightly more plausible than for A.
